claims.claim: Wakeup passes canonical preflight executor_required into durable dispatch. Admission accepts profileless executorless FINALIZE_CANDIDATE only when that requirement is false, rejects inconsistent Executor inputs before RUN creation, and preserves coding-action and NO_CHANGE requirements.

Executorless FINALIZE_CANDIDATE reaches the ordinary continuation path, which binds repair lineage, reuses the admitted structural package without persisting an execution profile or invoking a coding dispatcher, and submits the package to Runtime completion with TASK verification.

Version 3 dispatch records persist executor_required and retain distinct FINALIZE_CANDIDATE action identity. Replay and binding enforce immutable selectors and profiles; executorless RUN attribution checks inherited Executor lineage, exact TASK binding, and profile absence. Legacy record reading remains supported.

Added regression coverage for executorless FINALIZE wakeup through durable admission and fresh verification, explicit-Executor rejection without RUN creation, coding fallback, action isolation, profile rejection, selector collisions, and terminal reconciliation.
The committed changes affect only four scope.modify files and add no semantic, lifecycle, routing, or retry authority. TASK-313 artifacts and roadmap planning state remain untouched.
